title: AID Protocol v2 — AcceptanceEvidence
description: Artifact emitted by C2 recording evidence that each acceptance criterion has been evaluated and the outcome of that evaluation.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

acceptance_evidence.$comment: enforced — minimal payload; full schema defined in owning phase (E5). All properties optional at top level (D5 observe/best-effort compat).

items.$comment: ac_id = sha256(ac_text)[:12]+step_idx (content-addressable, stable across runs for same AC text)

ac_id.$comment: sha256(ac_text)[:12]+step_idx — content-addressable identifier for the acceptance criterion

source.$comment: original AC text preserved for auditability

covered.$comment: LLM matching result — C2 verifier determines this; bash only aggregates

evidence_ref.$comment: path to evidence artifact supporting the coverage claim

deviation.$comment: none=criterion fully covered; missing=AC not met; changed=requirement drifted from original

coverage_mode.$comment: C2 uses LLM matching for coverage determination; bash aggregates — D3
